item.title: The midterm elections’ blue wave could throw a wrench in SpaceX’s mobile ambitions
item.description: To launch the new division, SpaceX will have to jump through legislative hoops, and that could be more challenging with Democrats in charge. Elon Musk has made no secret of his hopes of turning SpaceX into a viable competitor to mobile companies like Verizon and AT&T. But with the Democrats’ resounding victory in the 2026 midterm elections, that plan is suddenly thrown into question....
